summary: Pearson plc filed a Form 6-K on 12 August 2026 disclosing PDMR share transactions. Tom ap Simon, President of Higher Education and Virtual Learning, sold 119,624 ADRs on 10 August 2026 at prices ranging $16.33–$16.40 per ADR, for aggregate proceeds of $1,955,217.38. This is a routine insider transaction disclosure, not a special situation. No strategic corporate action, offer, or board recommendation is involved. The filing is purely administrative under SEC Rule 13a-16 for foreign private issuers.
